text:
claire: quick review of modal actions in the new console mock. two things: action spacing feels inconsistent with other components and the close hit target is small on mobile.

ben: saw that. spacing between title + actions is 6px in the mock, other headers use 12px. feels visually cramped.

claire: propose a semantic token `--modal-action-gap: 12px` and map current instances. keeps atomic spacing tokens free for low-level use.

oscar: agree. also the close icon is 16px with 4px padding. can we increase interactive area to 44px without changing visual size? same pattern we've used elsewhere.

ben: CSS idea:
```css
.modal .close { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0; }
.modal .close .icon { width:16px; height:16px; }
.modal .actions { gap: var(--modal-action-gap, 12px); }
```

claire: add `aria-label=\"Close modal\"` and ensure `:focus-visible` uses `--focus-ring` token. small copy nit: primary action in the draft says "Run" which is vague; suggest "Start run" or "Start job" depending on context.

oscar: i'll change copy to "Start run" in the mock. i'll also prototype collapsing tertiary actions into a kebab under 420px to avoid overcrowding.

design-bot: Task created: COMPONENTS-701 "modal: modal-action-gap token, close hit target, focus token alignment, mobile kebab fallback" Milestone: 2.21.0.

claire: thanks — if no objections we'll merge token and CSS tweak after PR review. resolving thread.
